The *Maṅgalabuddhavaṁsa* ("The History of the Buddha Maṅgala", Bv 5) is the fifth chapter of the *Buddhavaṁsa*, located within the late Khuddaka Nikāya collection of the Pali canon [SuttaCentral]. The text recounts the life story, characteristics, and spiritual legacy of the past Buddha Maṅgala [SuttaCentral]. SuttaCentral records two modern translations across two languages [SuttaCentral].

Computational text-reuse analysis by DharmaNexus indicates substantial internal reuse across Pali literature, registering 344 matching passages shared across 27 texts [DharmaNexus]. Its largest textual partner is its commentary, the *Buddhavaṃsa-aṭṭhakathā* (154 matches, including an extended match spanning §9.4–17.4) [DharmaNexus]. The chapter also shares formulaic biographical and narrative verses with several other chapters of the *Buddhavaṁsa*, including the *Phussabuddhavaṁsa* (Bv 20), *Padumuttarabuddhavaṁsa* (Bv 12), *Sumedhabuddhavaṁsa* (Bv 13), *Koṇḍaññabuddhavaṁsa* (Bv 4), and *Sujātabuddhavaṁsa* (Bv 14) [DharmaNexus].

In cross-language automated alignments, DharmaNexus detects strong textual correspondence between the *Maṅgalabuddhavaṁsa* and the Sanskrit *Mahāvastu-avadāna* (with high-scoring alignments at the text's opening, §0.1–1.2), as well as lower-scoring matches with the *Gaṇḍavyūhasūtra* [DharmaNexus]. Tibetan alignments connect sections of the work to the *Jātakanidāna* (D0032), the *Bhadrakalpikāsūtra* (D0094), and the *Bodhisattvagocaropāyaviṣayavikurvāṇanirdeśasūtra* (D0146) [DharmaNexus].
